04
Who this works for
Built for one specific kind of company. We will say so on the call if it is not you.
We work with
B2B companies at $10,000+ annual contract value with a closer ready to take meetings inside five business days of booking.
SaaS, agencies, consulting, fractional services, B2B services. The economics of cold outbound at 2026 deliverability standards do not work below that ACV.
If your motion is wrong for this channel, we will tell you on the call before either of us wastes another minute. Cold outbound only pays off above a certain ACV and inside a specific set of motions. Outside that it just burns domains and budget, so if the fit is not there, we say so early.

Who runs this
One operator. Eight clients. No handoffs.
I am Kerim Efe Ozcanli. Background in business development, marketplace operations, and demand generation across B2B and fast moving ecommerce. I write your copy, pick your lists, set up your sequences, and read every reply that comes back. The same person you book the call with is the person running your account, every week, for as long as you stay.
I cap the roster at eight active clients. When it is full, the waitlist opens. This is intentional. Outbound at this quality cannot be done at scale by one person, and I will not pretend otherwise.
The strategy call is the fastest way to see how I work.

06
FAQ
Common questions.
How long until we see results?
First sequences go live around week three after warmup. In this category, first booked calls typically land in weeks four to six. Real signal on what is working takes 60 days. Anything faster is luck or a misleading dashboard.
What kind of results should I expect?
Outbound is a numbers game and I run it like one. On a $10k+ ACV motion a tuned system lands in the 2 to 4 percent reply range, and once sequences are live and warm, the goal is a steady flow of interested buyers booking calls; we report against that every month. In this category, first meetings usually hit the calendar inside weeks four to six. You see the real numbers from me every week, the wins and the misses both, so you always know exactly what the system is returning and where it is headed.
Will you use our main domain?
No. We send from separate lookalike domains we set up for you. This protects your primary domain reputation and is standard practice in 2026.
Written by AI or by people?
Templates are written by a human operator. AI personalizes the opening line for each prospect based on real signal. Pure AI sequences get filtered and ignored.
What is the commitment?
Founding cohort engagements are 12 months at the locked rate. Outbound needs at least 90 days to produce a clean read, and we want enough runway for the system to compound. After the 12 month term, the engagement rolls into a monthly term you can end with 30 days notice. The two strike exit clause applies throughout.
How is pricing structured?
A flat monthly fee, no per meeting markup, no per seat charges. We share the exact number on the strategy call once we confirm the engagement fits. No hidden costs after that.
Where is Caliber based?
Caliber Outbound is a US registered LLC based in Reno, Nevada. All operations run on Pacific Time and all client communication is in English. I am originally from Turkey, and I run the business solo from US business hours. No offshore teams, no overseas contractors.
Stop running outbound on the side.
One 30 minute call. We learn your ICP, you see exactly how the system works. No pitch deck, no slides.
The math
Month 1 is setup and warmup. By month 2 sequences are live and replies are landing; first meetings typically follow as the system warms.
One in house SDR runs about $135k a year
and stays 14 months on average before you are hiring and ramping all over again.
This system costs a fraction of that,
never quits, and scales the day you want more volume. You get an operator who has run this motion, not a junior learning on your pipeline.
You own everything from day one.
The sending domains, the sequences, and the full prospect database stay yours whether you keep working with me or not.
Two consecutive 60 day windows with no traction and we part ways, no penalty.
I only want clients this actually works for, and I will tell you on the first call if that is not you.
